# awscontrib_connect_routing_profiles (Data Source)

Lists Amazon Connect routing profiles in an instance, with optional tag and case-sensitive name substring filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connect_instance_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Amazon Connect instance identifier."
}

variable "routing_profile_name_contains" {
  type        = string
  description = "Case-sensitive substring used to filter routing profile names."
}

variable "routing_profile_tags" {
  type        = map(string)
  description = "Tag key/value pairs that routing profiles must all match."
  default     = {}
}

data "awscontrib_connect_routing_profiles" "example" {
  instance_id   = var.connect_instance_id
  name_contains = var.routing_profile_name_contains
  tags          = var.routing_profile_tags
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier.

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Optional case-sensitive literal substring matched against routing profile names.
- `tags` (Map of String) Optional tag filters. A profile must match every supplied key and value.

### Read-Only

- `routing_profiles` (Attributes List) Routing profiles sorted by profile ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--routing_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) Profile Amazon Resource Name.
- `id` (String) Profile identifier.
- `name` (String) Profile name.
